name: PS5 Uninstaller
description: Native PS5 homebrew uninstall and storage management utility by YAHBALLON. Browse installed games, homebrew folders and USB PKG archives in a controller-friendly interface with title artwork, versions, sizes and file locations. Includes native uninstall requests, supported ShadowMountPlus-managed source cleanup, USB folder cleanup, progress feedback, safety confirmations and diagnostic logging. Removing a PKG archive does not uninstall the already installed game.
author: YAHBALLON
